about.title: About
about.body: I’m passionate about technology and innovation: a systems engineer building generative AI and cloud automation. I like designing scalable products that deliver real value. I compete in hackathons, explore new ways to apply tech, and learn as I go. I’ve also led volunteer engineering for web and chatbot projects in the FIIS community (Centro Cultural Núcleo).
